    """
    Set raw data at the path in vault. The vault policy used must allow this.

    CLI Example:

    .. code-block:: bash

            salt '*' vault.write_raw "secret/my/secret" '{"user":"foo","password": "bar"}'
    """
    client = _get_client(path)
